Student activist কেন্দ্রীয় সেল সমন্বয়কারী, প্রাইভেট বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় সেল — বৈষম্যবিরোধী ছাত্র আন্দোলন

Organising private university students into the national movement. Dhaka, Bangladesh.

পরিচয়

Who I am

My activism began in 2018 and has not stopped since. It began with a demand for fairness, and it continues with the work of organising.

I am a student activist and a student of the School of Pharmacy, BRAC University. My activism began in the 2018 Anti-Quota Movement and continued through the 2024 July Mass Uprising, where I took to the streets alongside fellow students in the struggle for justice and equality.

As a central coordinator of the Private University Cell of the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement and a central organiser of Private University Unity, I have worked to bring private university students into the national movement and to give them a united, organised voice.

I remain committed to a fair, accountable and discrimination-free Bangladesh, and to representing the interests of students in shaping its future.

সময়রেখা

The road so far
  1. 2018

    Anti-Quota Movementকোটা বিরোধী আন্দোলন

    Where it started. Students across the country mobilised for reform of the government job quota system — my first time organising and marching with them.

  2. জুলাই ২০২৪ · July 2024

    July Mass Uprisingজুলাই গণঅভ্যুত্থান

    I took to the streets alongside fellow students in the struggle for justice and equality, through the days of confrontation in Chattogram and Dhaka.

  3. ২৮ আগস্ট ২০২৫ · 28 August 2025

    Appointed to the Private University Cellকেন্দ্রীয় সেল সমন্বয়কারী হিসেবে নিয়োগ

    Named a coordinator of the Private University Cell in the central committee circular of the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement, representing BRAC University.

  4. এখন · Now

    Building Private University Unityপ্রাইভেট বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় ঐক্য

    Organising students across private campuses into one voice — on justice, on safety for women, and on a discrimination-free Bangladesh.
